page.notes: The entry "fieri queat è duobus entib." stands at the top right, beside the first entry; it may belong to that entry or be a separate line. Doubtful readings: "abstractum" (the printed word is hard to read, so it is marked), "sensile" in the entry on non omne fieri potest, and "dumatur" in the entry on infinitum. The final line is partly legible only. The left block of three to four italic lines at the bottom left is a separate column; its first line "in tapnitum 104" is doubtful, and the words "vilum" and "pluro" in the Ens creatum entry are uncertain as read. The catchword "Ens" stands at the lower right.
